timing: User confirmed characters restore SP at the start of their turns, 2026-09-05.
sourceType: Lufel Tempest Riko guide, not a directly captured game tooltip
implementation: Live profile: recover up to 10 SP at beginActorTurn, capped at ordinary max SP without reducing existing overcap. Normal and Concert owner-turn entries use the same hook. Free commands and repeated hits do not enter this hook. Resuming a saved turn after Concert does not create another turn-start recovery.
limitations: The guide documents upward rounding for SP Recovery modifiers. Modifier application remains pending because current simulator values mix a 100 fallback with equipped 0 and 5 percent values.
This implements natural base recovery only; it does not claim exact SP parity with the recording.
The separate 35 SP party restoration on Showstopper activation remains in place.
The user-requested 180 maximum SP for Marian and Berry remains in place.
